title: Deploy Site Fixture
description: Node-only prebuild proof for the reusable deploy-site.yml workflow.

import rules from '../../generated/rules.json';

This scratch Starlight site proves the reusable `deploy-site.yml` `prebuild`
seam works with **no Python leg** (`python-version: ""`). The prebuild is a
Node-only script (`scripts/gen-rules.mjs`) that emits
`src/generated/rules.json`, which this page then renders at build time — so the
build fails loudly if the prebuild step never ran.

**Generated rule count:** {rules.ruleCount}

<ul>
	{rules.rules.map((rule) => (
		<li>
			<strong>{rule.id}</strong> ({rule.severity}) — {rule.description}
		</li>
	))}
</ul>
